datasets.name: WELFake
datasets.notes: Official 0=fake, 1=real; remapped to 1=risk. Historical publisher/topic bias. Article grouping and exact deduplication applied.

datasets.name: HC3 English
datasets.size: 24K+ questions with human and ChatGPT answers
datasets.access: Public download; CC BY-SA 4.0 plus underlying source terms
datasets.notes: Split by question so human/AI answers to one question stay together. Historical ChatGPT only; modern-generator evaluation still required.

datasets.name: CIFAKE
datasets.access: Public Hugging Face mirror preserves original train/test splits
datasets.notes: 32×32 CIFAR-10 real vs Stable Diffusion 1.4. Not suitable as an image manipulation or modern generator benchmark.

datasets.name: LIAR
datasets.notes: Use official test only for cross-domain evaluation. Exclude half-true, document binary mapping. Never tune on the test.

datasets.name: CASIA v2 / IMD2020
datasets.access: Acquire dataset from its provider under its terms; import using training/prepare_media.py
datasets.notes: Group by original source image and all edited derivatives. Classification and tamper masks are different supervision tasks.

datasets.name: FaceForensics++ / Celeb-DF v2
datasets.size: FF++ 1,000 original videos plus manipulations; Celeb-DF 6,229 videos
datasets.access: Provider access request required; do not bypass consent forms
datasets.notes: Train on FF++; evaluate unseen identities, methods and Celeb-DF. Group all frames/clips from the same original identity/source.

datasets.name: ASVspoof 2019 LA / 2021 DF
datasets.access: Download from official Zenodo releases and import provider protocols
datasets.notes: Honor official speaker-disjoint partitions. 2021 DF is an external benchmark, not extra training data. Report EER as well as AUC.

datasets.name: M4 / GenImage / DF40
datasets.access: Optional provider releases; not yet trained in this project
datasets.notes: Recommended expansion after initial baseline evaluation. More rows alone do not guarantee better accuracy.
